spans.s:
Vaikhānasa is the name of a mythical group of ṛṣis who are said in the pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa to have been slain at munimaraṇa by rahasyu devamalimluc, and who are mentioned in the taittirīya Āraṇyaka also. An individual vaikhānasa is puruhanman.
Foot notes xiv. 4, 7.
i. 23, 3 (Indische Studien, 1, 78).
xiv. 9, 29.
